landmark_pins.name: Tanguar / Shanir Haor Core Lake
landmark_pins.description: Permanent tectonic wetland core with specular dark L-band signature.
landmark_pins.plain_language_explanation: [Herbaceous Wetland] Persistent open water signature: HH averaged -18.9 dB and HV averaged -26.8 dB across all 12 passes. Specular forward reflection off smooth water scatters L-band energy away from the sensor.

landmark_pins.name: Seasonal Haor Bed (Drainage Zone)
landmark_pins.description: Inland sea during monsoon that drains in October/November for Boro planting.
landmark_pins.plain_language_explanation: [Permanent Water Body] Persistent open water signature: HH averaged -15.9 dB and HV averaged -24.0 dB across all 12 passes. Specular forward reflection off smooth water scatters L-band energy away from the sensor.

landmark_pins.name: Haor Margin Aman Cropland
landmark_pins.description: Elevated rim cropland with strong vegetative HV volume scattering peak.
landmark_pins.plain_language_explanation: [Cropland (ESA WorldCover)] Monsoon flood submergence: HH backscatter dropped by -3.9 dB between 2026-06-18 and 2026-06-30 (reaching a minimum of -18.2 dB HH / -22.4 dB HV), consistent with new open water inundation.

landmark_pins.name: Submerged Reed & Hijal Swamp (Double-Bounce)
landmark_pins.description: Flooded wetland vegetation where L-band bounces off water and vertical trunks.
landmark_pins.plain_language_explanation: [Cropland (ESA WorldCover)] Monsoon flood submergence: HH backscatter dropped by -15.3 dB between 2026-07-12 and 2026-07-24 (reaching a minimum of -19.9 dB HH / -25.6 dB HV), consistent with new open water inundation.

landmark_pins.name: Elevated Haor Village Mound (Hati)
landmark_pins.description: Settlement built on raised earthen kanda/hati mound above floodwaters.
landmark_pins.plain_language_explanation: [Tree Cover / Homestead Forest] High persistent backscatter (mean HH = 15.9 dB, HV = -9.1 dB): Consistent with dense settlement structures, embankments, or homestead tree cover.

landmark_pins.name: Flash-Flooded Haor Depression
landmark_pins.description: Rapid backscatter drop triggered by monsoon runoff from the Meghalaya hills.
landmark_pins.plain_language_explanation: [Permanent Water Body] Monsoon flood submergence: HH backscatter dropped by -21.8 dB between 2026-06-18 and 2026-06-30 (reaching a minimum of -14.7 dB HH / -20.9 dB HV), consistent with new open water inundation.
